<description>
A second btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks call on the same chainstate manager, while one is in progress, aborts the process, and the kernel header does not say so. I document it. The abort is the assert in ImportingNow in node/blockstorage.cpp, which I keep.
</description>

<commits>
2077d1571e kernel: document the import_blocks abort

A second btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks call on the same
chainstate manager, while one is in progress, aborts the process. The
header does not say so.

I add it to the header. I keep the assert in ImportingNow.
</commits>

<patch>
diff --git a/src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h b/src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h
index ce051bda7b..b49ccf1310 100644
--- a/src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h
+++ b/src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h
@@ -1330,6 +1330,10 @@ BITCOINKERNEL_API btck_BlockValidationState* BITCOINKERNEL_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT bt
  * set for the chainstate manager. Can also import an array of existing block
  * files selected by the user.
  *
+ * Do not call this while another btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks call
+ * on the same chainstate manager is in progress. The process aborts when this
+ * is detected.
+ *
  * @param[in] chainstate_manager        Non-null.
  * @param[in] block_file_paths_data     Nullable, array of block files described by their full filesystem paths.
  * @param[in] block_file_paths_lens     Nullable, array containing the lengths of each of the paths.

</patch>
